jobs.occupation: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d) (Kundeninformationsfachkraft)
jobs.description: The CompanyUndagrid is part of the EnOcean group and delivers end-to-end asset tracking and IoT solutions that give customers in aviation, logistics and industry full visibility of their assets, equipment and operations. The Undagrid platform combines self-powered and battery-driven sensor devices with BLE-based indoor positioning, GPS/GNSS outdoor tracking and cellular IoT connectivity, and turns the resulting data into dashboards, analytics and reports that customers rely on every day. We are the leader in sensing and control products for IoT infrastructures and combine it with energy harvesting technologies for maintenance-free solutions that gain their energy from the environment enabling a sustainable world.The Role & YouYou are the technical face of our asset tracking platform towards our worldwide customer base. Working side by side with Sales, Product Management and Engineering, you guide customers from the first platform demonstration through deployment, training and day-to-day operations, and make sure they get measurable value out of our solutions. As an integral part of a global Customer Success team, you combine hands-on platform expertise with a strong feel for our customers’ business processes, and you turn what you learn in the field into better products.This position can be based in either Munich (Germany) , Copenhagen (Denmark) or Utrecht (the Netherlands) . We are recruiting for one role and will hire one candidate . The employment contract will be concluded with the local EnOcean entity at the selected location. Please apply only once and indicate your preferred location.#LI-HybridWhat you’ll be doing• Act as the primary technical counterpart in customer meetings alongside Sales and PM, and build strong relationships with technical, operational and management stakeholders on the customer side• Deliver compelling platform demonstrations and showcase advanced functionality in a way that creates confidence and excitement with customers• Support solution design and deployment planning for new customer projects, and support our customers worldwide in deploying EnOcean and Undagrid solutions in their network and IT infrastructure• Configure and administer the platform independently, including tenant creation, user management, dashboard setup, reporting and minor customizations to meet customer requirements• Deliver technical and operational training for customer teams, from end users to administrators and IT stakeholders• Travel to customer sites when needed to support deployments, training, workshops, troubleshooting and business reviews• Validate our solutions in the field and at customer sites, identify technical problems and drive them to resolution• Collect customer requirements and translate them into actionable improvements and product feedback, working closely with our sales, product marketing, product management and engineering teamsWhat we’re looking for• BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a relevant field, combined with 5–10 years of experience in the asset tracking, IoT, RTLS, telematics, or related industries• Solid understanding of both indoor and outdoor tracking technologies: BLE-based indoor positioning and proximity tracking, GPS/GNSS-based outdoor tracking, as well as cellular IoT, telematics and fleet tracking concepts• Experience working with asset tracking platforms, dashboards, analytics and customer reporting, as well as with tools such as Grafana, git and Jira• Experience in installing and configuring network equipment, ideally in the field of aviation or logistics• Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills across hardware, connectivity and software domains• Good understanding of business processes and operational use cases, enabling you to discuss both technical capabilities and business value with customers• Ability to communicate effectively with everyone from operational users and IT departments to senior management, paired with a hands-on, problem-solving attitude in direct customer contact• Willingness to travel worldwide and to adjust your working schedule to support customers in different time zones• Fluent English is a must, additional language skills are a plusWhat we offer and what you can expect• Flexible working hours, well balanced work-life ratio• Work in an international and interdisciplinary team with great spirit• Freedom to express and develop yourself• Be part of a company that develops innovative technology for a greener world

jobs.occupation: Director Global Quality (m/f/x) (Leiter/in - Qualitätsmanagement)
jobs.description: Director Global Quality (m/f/x)Wieland-Werke AG I Ulm I Business Unit Thermal Solutions I Ident. Code 2026-0154 I immediatelyUnleash potential.Copper connects the world - in technologies, such as eMobility, energy and data transfer, refrigeration and air conditioning technology, digitalization and the Internet of Things. Surprise us with your fresh thinking, new impulses and shape the world of tomorrow. Discover numerous opportunities to unleash your potential.Wieland stands for diversity and equal opportunities - for this reason, we welcome individual applications regardless of age, gender, nationality, religion, ethnic and social background.Director Global Quality (m/f/x) Your FutureIn this newly created key leadership role, you will shape the development of a globally aligned quality organization and support sustainable international growth. Together with our manufacturing sites around the world, you will establish global quality standards, drive the digital transformation of our quality organization and ensure consistently high product quality across our international operations.- Strategy: As Director Global Quality (m/f/d), you will define and drive the global quality strategy for our Thermal Solutions Business Unit. You will establish a unified quality framework across our international manufacturing sites and align them around shared quality objectives.- Transformation: You will play a key role in shaping the future of our global quality organization. By harmonizing quality systems, processes and standards, you will build a scalable organization that supports international growth and the successful integration of newly acquired sites.- Digitalization: You will drive the digital transformation of our quality management processes by implementing modern Quality Management Systems (QMS) and data-driven performance management tools, increasing transparency, efficiency and operational excellence across all locations.- Operational Excellence: You will manage global quality KPIs, lead cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives and foster a culture of operational excellence across the entire organization, ensuring sustainable performance improvements.- Global Collaboration: Working closely with our manufacturing sites as well as cross-functional teams in Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain and other business functions, you will establish globally aligned quality standards and successfully integrate new sites into our global quality framework.- Customer Focus: Together with our global teams, you will ensure outstanding quality throughout the entire product lifecycle. By enabling successful new product introductions, reducing scrap rates and enhancing customer satisfaction, you will create measurable value for our customers worldwide.Your Potential- Education: You hold a Master's degree in Quality Management, Operations, Engineering or a comparable field.- Leadership: You bring extensive leadership experience in global quality management within an international manufacturing environment and are experienced in operating within a matrix organization.- Transformation Expertise: You have successfully led international transformation and standardization initiatives and have a proven track record of developing global quality organizations.- Technical Expertise: You possess in-depth knowledge of modern Quality Management Systems and Lean Management, complemented by strong analytical, strategic and systemic thinking.- Personality: You are an empathetic and inspiring leader with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of bringing people together and driving sustainable change across international organizations.- Language: You communicate fluently in German and English. Italian or French language skills are considered an advantage.- Mobility: You enjoy working in an international environment and are willing to travel globally to collaborate closely with our manufacturing sites and stakeholders worldwide.Your Benefits- A Great Place to Work: Join a motivated team where collaboration, mutual respect and a positive working atmosphere are part of our everyday culture.- Comprehensive Benefits: Benefit from an attractive package including a company pension scheme, childcare support, Christmas gifts for employees' children, employee appreciation gifts, subsidized meals in our company restaurant with healthy food options, and a wide range of employee discounts.- Health & Well-being: Your health matters to us. We support your well-being through a variety of initiatives, including Wellpass, our in-house health program ("Vitalwerkstatt") and company sports groups.- Health Services: We care about your physical and mental well-being. Our on-site occupational physicians and medical team are available whenever you need support. You also benefit from our orthopedic express service and free, confidential employee assistance program, offering professional advice and support for both work-related and personal matters – including your immediate family members.Interested?I am happy to answer your questions by email: recruiting@wieland.comMs Marina TikvicApplypowered by d.vinci
